explanation_en: On Ball 9.2, Shubman Gill hit Suyash Sharma for 4 runs. Your player Shubman Gill gained +7.0 points, increasing your team total to 172.5 points, but your simulated rank dropped by 219 to 1674 because other teams in the pool gained more points on this ball.

watch_next_en: Watch out, Shubman Gill needs just 16 more runs for his 50-run milestone bonus!
